name: brand-index
title: Brand index
description: A shop-by-brand page: popular brands as tiles, every brand under its letter with a product count, a search field and an A to Z jump bar.
docs: Pass brands (name, href, an optional count and logo { src, alt }) in any order: they are sorted for the locale and grouped under their first letter, with accents folded (Élan sits under E) and names that start with a number or a symbol under #. popular is a list of brand names to draw as tiles above the list, in that order. A tile shows the logo as a one-colour silhouette in the text colour, so pass a transparent SVG or PNG, or the brand's initials when there is no logo. The A to Z bar fills the width, scrolls sideways on a phone (the next letter peeks in to say so, and a search scrolls it to the first letter that still has a brand), sticks to the top (or below the CSS variable --sticky-top, which you set to the height of your own sticky header) and shows the letters that have no brand without linking them. The search field filters as you type, ignoring case and accents; the bar follows the matches, a polite status says how many brands match, and an empty result offers to show all brands. Every group is an h3 that a screen reader hears as 'Brands starting with A', and the columns balance on a wide screen and become one on a phone. linkAs renders every link with your router's Link: the links are drawn on the server and handed to the searchable part, so it works from a Server Component, and without JavaScript the whole list is there. With no brands at all it says so, with no count above it. locale, title, description, headingAs and labels do the usual.
